Name: Quaint Living - Buildings
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]This mod is my entry for the Stardew Valley Mod Fest 2026. If you like the buildings, I'd really appreciate your support by endorsing the mod![/center]
[line]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/G9OBL8T.png[/img][/center]

I've always loved the idea of an English cottage-inspired farmhouse, with overgrown roofs and semi-wild flowers climbing the walls (those poor bricks!). It's utterly beautiful. I tried to recreate that enchanting feeling, and I hope it comes through.


This initial release includes a seasonal farmhouse, silo, and shipping bin. I plan to create retextures for most - if not all - buildings eventually, so keep an eye out for updates.

[line]

Thank you all so much. I'm truly grateful to be able to share my work with you.

PC
